thread:
incident_bot: Pager alert — high GPU allocation failures in gcp-us-west1 (autoscaler failing to allocate new nodes). Queue depth increasing for prediction-prod, p95 latency spiking. Please ack on-call. :rotating_light:

ryan_oncall: Acked. Looking now. I see big queue growth on the inference queue, customers getting 503s. Minimal error spikes started ~5m ago.

mina_infra: Logs from autoscaler (snippet):
```
AutoscalerManager: scaleUp request for pool=prediction-prod, want=12, current=4
GCP API error: quotaExceeded - Insufficient regional quota 'NVIDIA_A100' for project projects/redwood-prod (requested 8, available 0)
Retrying in 30s (attempt 3)
```

sam_platform: Confirmed via cloud console — regional GPU quota for gcp-us-west1 shows 0 available for A100. There are some pending allocations from another project in the org that used a spike, looks like quota wasn't reclaimed. Also seeing: "compute.instances.insert: quotaExceeded" in a few zones.

alicia_ops: Customer impact: affecting outbound inference endpoints in us-west1. ETA for scale-up retries keeps failing. Proposing immediate mitigations: (1) enable cross-region fallback to us-central1 capacity (if compatible models available), (2) throttle non-production and low-priority work, (3) enable CPU fallback pool for small requests. Which is fastest to execute?

jess_sre: Fastest is throttling non-prod and enabling CPU fallback. Cross-region failover requires model variants in us-central1 and routing changes — doable but takes longer. I'll push a CPU-fallback canary now. Command I'll run:
```bash
# enable CPU fallback routing for prediction-prod
rdwctl route update prediction-prod --fallback cpu-small --priority low
```

mina_infra: Also tried a manual request to increase quota via gcloud, but that needs owner approval and won't be immediate. GCP support shows no auto-increase available for this account in that region. There's a stale allocation from project infra-batch that's holding 16 A100s; I'm reaching out to that team's oncall to release.

ryan_oncall: Okay do the CPU fallback canary + throttle non-prod. Marta, can you update customers on status? I'll keep coordinating infra and escalate to GCP if we cannot free quotas.

marta_support: On it. Drafting a short message for affected customers: "We're investigating increased errors for inference in us-west1. We're routing low-priority traffic away and bringing CPU fallback online to reduce errors. No data loss; ETA 30-45m for stabilization." Posting in status page now. :writing_hand:

sam_platform: One more data point: autoscaler logs show attempts across three zones in us-west1; some succeeded allocating CPU nodes but all GPU instance types failed with quotaExceeded. We can temporarily launch smaller cheaper GPU types in another region, but that changes performance and cost.

alicia_ops: Decision: 1) Throttle non-prod + reduce burst limit for prediction-prod by 30% (apply now). 2) Enable CPU fallback (jess doing). 3) If queue remains over threshold after 20m, start model routing to us-central1 for high-priority tenants only. 4) Escalate to GCP support and the org quota owners to reclaim the stale allocation.

jess_sre: CPU fallback pushed, confirming rollout: "traffic split: 70% gpu, 30% cpu-fallback for low-priority routes". Watching logs.

ryan_oncall: Monitoring... queue depth peaked at ~420 requests, now down to ~210 after throttles and fallback. p95 latency for remaining GPU path still high ~1.8s, CPU fallback p95 ~3.3s but success rate improved.

mina_infra: GCP support replied — escalation created, but manual reclaim request queued; could be 1-2 hours. The other project oncall responded and is releasing 8 GPUs now. Might reclaim capacity in ~12-20m.

marta_support: Status update posted to customers. Some replies asking about regional failover impact on latency; I've linked the runbook and noted degraded perf for routed customers.

sam_platform: Note: we'll want to review billing tags — the reclaimed GPUs belonged to infra-batch which forgot to set preemption policies. Filing an action item.

ryan_oncall: Handoff summary for nights: incident = GPU allocation failure causing autoscaler scale-ups to fail in gcp-us-west1. Current mitigations: non-prod throttle applied, CPU fallback enabled, partial cross-region routing on standby. Reclaimed 8 GPUs in ~15m expected; GCP escalation open. Metrics: queue still above baseline but stabilized. If queue > 500 or error rate > 5% for 15m, escalate to pager and enact forced cross-region routing for high-priority tenants.

ryan_oncall: Paging next on-call @jess_sre after 22:00 UTC. Leave this thread for the handoff, add notes in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2031045123

jess_sre: Acknowledged. I'll watch until reclaim completes and coordinate the possible region failover if needed. :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident note appended to tracker, severity set to S3 (regional capacity impacting production); started timeline at 2031045123.

marta_support: Closing customer-facing loop after 45m with update. Will reopen if we need to escalate externally.

ryan_oncall: Thanks team. Leave any lingering logs or config diffs here. I'll do a postmortem checklist once we get to steady state. :white_check_mark:
